text:
maria: Free to a good home — adjustable LED desk lamp (dimmable) + 24" 1080p monitor with VESA mount. Moving out of SF office Friday. Pickup South Park, can bring down to lobby. Photo: https://imgur.com/abcd123
alex: Condition? Any dead pixels on the monitor? Model?
maria: Monitor is BenQ GW2480, light scuffs on bezel, no dead pixels. Lamp like-new, cord a bit short but works fine. :sparkles:
jamie: i'll take monitor if nobody else claims it. can pick up fri afternoon. @maria
morgan: I can trade a small gas-spring monitor arm (VESA) if that helps someone pick up both — i need to get rid of mine anyway. would be perfect for the 24".
sasha: If jamie's grabbing monitor, i could take lamp? otherwise can ship for $12 via shippo if you want it mailed.
maria: @jamie sounds good — can you pick up after 3pm? @sasha shipping is fine, but prefer local pickup to avoid hassle. @morgan thanks — arm sounds useful, first come first serve when you arrive.
jamie: yep 3:15p works. sending DM with phone.
ops-bot: Reminder: please follow office pickup rules — sign out items at reception and put a sticky note with "Redwood giveaway".
alex: if jamie flakes i can swing by, otherwise glhf :thumbsup:
maria: thanks y'all! leaving them on the desk by window #4. label says "DO NOT REMOVE until 3pm" to avoid confusion. :memo:
jamie: picked up ✅ thanks @maria
sasha: I paid $12 for shipping and PMed tracking #US1234567890 — lamp on its way :ship:
morgan: left the arm on the chair, looks like it's claimed by whoever picked up the monitor. happy it's getting used :grin:
